exposure: estimated blood loss greater than 1,500 mL
Major obstetric hemorrhage (estimated blood loss > 1,500 mL)
outcome: Morbidity (lowest mean temperature, lowest mean pH, coagulopathy, hysterectomy)
cohort: Women with major obstetric hemorrhage at the study hospital
finding: Despite an increasing rate of major obstetric hemorrhage over the 14-year study period, mortality was eliminated and morbidity significantly decreased following the implementation of systematic changes in patient care.
